title: Verify: ui folders each hold a real crisp SVG unit tests
summary: Unit tests read the three ui folders and assert real, non-empty, crisp SVGs.
description: Read-only unit tests over the on-disk tree under game/public/assets/ui; no app is started.
acceptance_criteria: Given each of icons, frames and cursors, When listed, Then at least one .svg exists and is non-empty
Given each SVG, When read, Then it has width, height and crispEdges
technical_constraints: Use node:fs and import.meta.url like game/tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts

steps.action: Create a test with it.each(['icons','frames','cursors']) that lists ../public/assets/ui/<dir> via readdirSync, filters .svg, asserts length >= 1 and statSync size > 0 for each. Add a second it.each that reads each SVG and asserts it contains '<svg', a width="N" attribute, a height="N" attribute and shape-rendering="crispEdges".
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/publicAssetUi.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in publicAssetUi.test.ts pass (six cases)
